{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure fresh state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Identify valid ages (exclude -1)
valid_ages = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age on valid data
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age of converted customers, excluding -1 sentinels: {mean_age:.2f}")

# Confirm count of valid ages
print("Number of valid ages in converted group:", len(valid_ages))"}
